policies.title: 2024 RMI diplomatic-ties ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Parliament-hosted regulations issue a visitor visa upon arrival to citizens of countries with RMI diplomatic ties. The Ministry’s 2024 report directly records that the Republic established ties with each named country; ordinary visitors are therefore mapped as visa_on_arrival.
conditions: A visitor visa is issued upon arrival under regulation 7 only after the Director is satisfied about the return ticket, local address, and any other necessary information.
The visitor visa is valid for 90 days under regulation 7; issuance and final admission remain subject to immigration clearance and the Director’s statutory discretion.
This is an ordinary-visitor nationality baseline only; it does not infer eligibility for diplomatic, official, residence, employment, crew, sponsor, or other special routes.
